name: labs/tiagocoutinho__gepace
title: GE Druck Pace pressure controller (gepace.Pace)
intro: GE Druck Pace pressure controller (gepace.Pace), adapted from tiagocoutinho/gepace. It reads `idn`, `version`, `mac`, `task` and 11 more; runs `set_pressure_control`, `start_pressure_control` and `stop_pressure_control`. `set_pressure_control`: enable or disable the pressure control output of module 1 (OUTP1:STAT). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
